eyebrow.es: Clearwater Beach, FL · Estudio de tatuajes

parrafo.es: Psychotic Ink tatúa y perfora Clearwater Beach desde 1998. Se aceptan walk-ins para piezas personalizadas, estilo tradicional, fine line y cover-ups, y cada perforación se hace con equipo estéril y agujas nuevas selladas.
parrafo.en: Psychotic Ink has been tattooing and piercing Clearwater Beach since 1998. Walk-ins are welcome for custom pieces, traditional work, fine line and cover-ups, and every piercing is done with sterile equipment and fresh sealed needles.

parrafo_1.es: Psychotic Ink tatúa y perfora Clearwater Beach desde 1998. El estudio es veteran-owned, recibe walk-ins todos los días y en la playa se le conoce por un trabajo honesto y sin vueltas.
parrafo_1.en: Psychotic Ink has been tattooing and piercing Clearwater Beach since 1998. The shop is veteran-owned, walk-in friendly every day, and known on the beach for straightforward, honest work.

parrafo_2.es: Piezas personalizadas, tatuajes tradicionales, fine line y cover-ups salen de las mismas sillas, con los mismos artistas a los que los clientes vuelven a pedir por nombre.
parrafo_2.en: Custom pieces, traditional tattoos, fine line and cover-ups all come out of the same chairs, with the same artists clients keep coming back to ask for by name.

nosotros.imagen_2_alt: Traditional shark hand tattoo with flash flowers, done at Psychotic Ink

texto.es: Pásate en horario de atención o escribe por Instagram o al teléfono. Sin plataforma de reservas ni formularios: una respuesta directa.
texto.en: Walk in during open hours or send a message on Instagram or by phone. No booking platform, no forms, just a straightforward reply.

texto.es: Traes la idea, el tamaño y la zona; el artista te guía en el estilo, de tradicional a fine line, y te da una cotización honesta.
texto.en: You bring the idea, size and placement; the artist walks you through the style, from bold traditional lines to fine line detail, and gives you an honest quote.

texto.es: Cada pieza se hace con agujas nuevas y selladas, y cada perforación con joyería segura para implante, sea una pieza pequeña o una manga completa.
texto.en: Every piece is done with fresh, sealed needles, and every piercing with implant-safe jewelry, whether it is a small piece or a full sleeve.

texto.es: Sales con indicaciones claras de cuidado y un resultado sanado que, según las reseñas, mantiene líneas limpias años después.
texto.en: You leave with clear aftercare instructions and a healed result that reviewers describe holding clean lines years later.

nota.es: Cada tatuaje y perforación se cotiza en persona. Sin lista de precios fija.
nota.en: Every tattoo and piercing is quoted in person. No fixed price list.

texto.es: Trabajo tradicional americano a color y en negro y gris: los tiburones, pelícanos y flash que caracterizan al estudio en la playa.
texto.en: Bold color and black-and-grey American traditional work, the sharks, pelicans and flash pieces the shop is known for on the beach.

texto.es: Piezas de línea fina, limpias y detalladas, del tipo que las reseñas piden por nombre de artista.
texto.en: Clean, detailed fine line pieces, the kind reviewers specifically ask for by name.

texto.es: Tatuajes viejos o que ya no quieres, transformados en algo que sí quieras conservar, sin importar quién hizo el original.
texto.en: Old or unwanted tattoos reworked into something you will actually want to keep, no matter who did the original.

texto.es: Perforaciones de oreja, nariz y más, junto con el trabajo de tatuaje, en el mismo estudio que recibe walk-ins.
texto.en: Ear, nose and body piercing done alongside the tattoo work, in the same walk-in-friendly shop.

pie.es: Sin cita previa: se aceptan walk-ins todos los días. Escríbenos por Instagram o llama para preguntar por disponibilidad.
pie.en: No appointment needed: walk-ins are welcome every day. Message us on Instagram or call to ask about availability.

items.quote: My friend and I walked in and were taken care of right away. We had a great experience! We told them what we wanted and Aaron picked out a stencil for us and gave us the vision he had for our tattoo. Very clean and welcoming location. We were very pleased for Aaron to ensure that we see him take fresh needles out of the packaging. Highly recommend!

Awesome fine line work with attention to detail. Ask for Dustin. Support your local business. This place is the only place to get tattooed on Clearwater Beach. Down to earth, kind local artists and great prices!
me and my sister got matching tattoos. Adam was great super nice and very very very quick! They are great and our tattoos were $70 each. They also have $60 wall too
